reason: User authentication is complete (email verified, user_id obtained via find_user_id_by_email). The policy explicitly permits agents to 'provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products' once authenticated. get_user_details is the appropriate next step to retrieve the user's payment methods (for gift card balance check and payment history) and orders (to identify most recent order and its payment method). The tool call follows the one-at-a-time rule with no simultaneous message.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.
Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
